description: Source code for executor decoration factory functions, including helper templates for wrapping and decorating task executors with policies like sync, throttle, metrics, and tracing.

classes.name: wrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for task_executor references, enabling conversion to unique_ptr<task_executor>.

methods.name: convert_to_unique_executor_ptr
methods.description: Converts various executor types to a std::unique_ptr<task_executor>.

methods.name: make_executor_decorator_helper
methods.description: Recursively applies decoration policies to a task_executor, wrapping it with sync, throttle, metrics, or trace decorators based on policies.

methods.name: validate_config
methods.description: Checks execution decoration configuration for incompatible options, e.g., metrics and trace enabled simultaneously.

methods.name: decorate_executor
methods.description: Public API to decorate a task_executor with policies specified in execution_decoration_config.
